POLICE BLOTTER — Tremondre McGhee was booked into the Webb County Jail on Tuesday night, October 20, 2026, on two misdemeanor charges, according to Webb County booking records.

Tremondre McGhee — arrested on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 10:54 p.m. Booking #202608910. Charged with (1) failure to identify — giving false or fictitious information (Class B misdemeanor) and (2) resisting arrest, search or transport (Class A misdemeanor), both under Case #PFCC26-003313L1. Bond had not been set on either charge as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The booking record lists his city as Albuquerque, New Mexico; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

A Class A misdemeanor in Texas is punishable by up to one year in county jail and a fine of up to $4,000; a Class B misdemeanor is punishable by up to 180 days in county jail and a fine of up to $2,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Tremondre McGhee is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Booking #202608910, Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal (Case #PFCC26-003313L1).

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956

Webb Watch 956

title: Police Blotter: Tremondre McGhee Booked on Misdemeanor Charges in Webb County
